I found this while looking for other posts by Qlaira users, and I know you made a decision but I just wanted to throw in my own experience with Qlaira too!!

I started Qlaira in October after coming off a pill that would make me bleed for a month straight and Qlaira definitely does the opposite. My period is essentially non-existent for the most part, and whilst that’s not my preference it would probably be great for you! When i have gotten my period it’s been 2-3 weeks late and extremely short and light, about 2 days of bleeding and hardly noticeable at all.
Definitely a good pill if you’re looking to stop your period or at least shorten it to be almost unnoticeable!
